AnimatedBoundary and TracedPath

Source: R/changing.R
AnimatedBoundaryClass.Rd

AnimatedBoundary() draws a boundary around a VMobject that cycles through colors while the scene runs. TracedPath() leaves a trail behind a moving point, optionally fading after dissipating_time seconds.

Usage

AnimatedBoundary(
  vmobject,
  colors = c(BLUE_D, BLUE_B, BLUE_E, GREY_BROWN),
  max_stroke_width = 3,
  cycle_rate = 0.5,
  back_and_forth = TRUE,
  draw_rate_func = smooth_rate,
  fade_rate_func = smooth_rate,
  ...
)

TracedPath(
  traced_point_func,
  stroke_width = 2,
  stroke_color = "#FFFFFF",
  dissipating_time = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

vmobject

The VMobject to outline.

colors

Colors to cycle through.

max_stroke_width

Maximum stroke width.

cycle_rate

Cycles per second.

back_and_forth

Draw back and forth.

draw_rate_func, fade_rate_func

Rate functions for drawing and fading.

...

Passed to VGroup() or VMobject().

traced_point_func

Function with no arguments returning the point to trace.

stroke_width, stroke_color

Style of the trace.

dissipating_time

Seconds after which the trace fades, or NULL.

Value

A mobject: an R6 object of the class named by the function called. The objects whose names end in Class are the R6 class generators that these functions call.
